name: Helmerich & Payne, Inc.
summary: Helmerich & Payne, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides drilling solutions and technologies for oil and gas exploration and production companies. The company operates through North America Solutions, Offshore Solutions, International Solutions, and Other Operations segments. The North America Solutions segment conducts operations in Texas. The International Solutions segment conducts drilling operations in Saudi Arabia, Oman, Argentina, and internationally. The Offshore Solutions segment operates offshore rig fleet on conventional fixed leg platforms and floating platforms attached to the sea floor with mooring lines, such as spars and tension leg platforms.
